name: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd
title: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd - 540701 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 19% to INR 851 crore and FY26 EBITDA margin 19.3%, but Q4 was hit by INR 50-odd crore onerous-contract provisions, and no capacity additions are planned beyond partner-funded co-investment.

capex.quote: there are no major CapEx plans apart from the co-investment that we are doing with the Japanese innovator, where 100% of the CapEx financing is being done by the partner.

triggers.label: No major capex; partner funds co-investment
triggers.quote: there are no major CapEx plans apart from the co-investment that we are doing with the Japanese innovator, where 100% of the CapEx financing is being done by the partner.

triggers.label: FY27 growth guidance withheld
triggers.quote: we would remain cautious as far as the guidance for the year is concerned

triggers.label: Onerous-contract provisions up ~INR 30 cr YoY
triggers.quote: we had to make in the quarter ending March 31, 2026, on account of the onerous contracts

guidance.quote: we do expect close to about 15% as the CAGR over the next 3 years
Our target remains the same, which is to get to the 25% mark in the year after next, that is FY28.
that would be at least to the tune of about CHF 10-15 million. So, roughly about INR 150-odd crores every year
FY28 with these new orders and RFQs in hand, we should be looking at INR 500 crore-plus kind of top line.

guidance.value: not more than INR 70-odd crore for FY27
guidance.quote: I would say we would see a net interest cost of not more than INR 70-odd crores for the full financial year.
So, for FY27, it could be close to about 40% for the full financial year.

guidance.value: EUR ~6 million loss FY27; profitable in FY28
guidance.quote: the losses should come down to close to about EUR 6 million.
